## Activity

During May 2022, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 363 captures. Session lists ran as planned, apart from routine leave. Activity was recorded for the month in line with the clinic’s scheduled image capture work. The completed captures provide the basis for the subsequent image quality review and grading activity.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 12 were ungradable. This represented an ungradable rate of 3.3 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and were recorded separately in the monthly activity results. The image quality findings should be considered alongside the overall capture volume when reviewing site performance.

## Grading

Grading identified 81 referable results. The median lag from photograph to grade was 23 days. This records the time between image capture and completion of grading for the month. The results provide the monthly summary for Harbour Eye Clinic and support routine monitoring of image quality, grading outcomes and reporting times.
